prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent modular WALK clothing atlas for Bagseed. Reference 1 is the LOCKED headless mannequin pose atlas: preserve its joint positions, neck/collar opening, shoulder/hip heights, wrist and hand positions, knees, ankles, each lifted foot, exact stride, body proportions and feet baseline FRAME FOR FRAME. Reference 2 is the approved player illustration for organic cloth folds, outlines and soft shading. EXACT layout FOUR columns by FOUR rows, a portrait atlas about 1152x1728 (2:3); rows FRONT/down, RIGHT PROFILE, BACK/up, LEFT PROFILE; columns the corresponding FOUR distinct approved walk poses. Keep the large transparent upper headroom and each body in the LOWER half of its cell, at the exact source scale and location. NECK DOWN ONLY: no head, hair, face, ears, hat, bust portraits or extra characters. True transparent alpha, no ground, no shadows, no text, no grid, separate cells with generous transparent gutters. Keep the source average-build young-adult body with short friendly proportions. All exposed skin is warm tan #cf9670, natural connected individual hands and toes. No 3D, vector-flat shapes, stiff stick figures or warped anatomy. No pose reinterpretation, no added limb, no torso resizing, no direction changes within a row. Original expressive hand-illustrated indie-RPG finish: tailored moving cloth, organic folds, warm dark outlines, restrained value shading. Only the requested garment changes; every companion item is fixed consistently across all sixteen cells. Important material keys: top fabric medium blue #5086bf, bottoms dark navy #36405a, shoe leather brown #2b1d14; shade each fabric only with VALUE changes in its own key hue. Preserve cream/white details and small brass buttons. Reproduce the exact body geometry of reference 1 rather than drawing a new body. Plain short-sleeve CREW-NECK T-SHIRT in medium key-blue #5086bf, natural short sleeve hems above elbows, tan exposed forearms and original tan hands at EXACT locked wrist/hand positions. No logo or pattern. Companion dark-navy JEANS and brown cream-soled SNEAKERS.
CORRECT THE SMALL POSE OFFSETS in up/1 (zero based direction/frame). The earlier source hands were too low or too far out. Keep the mannequin's wrist and hand contour at precisely the same location and scale; keep the same fitted shoulders and collar. Draw garment onto the exact mannequin anatomy, not a new bulkier figure. Every figure MUST retain the exact mannequin outline wherever skin is exposed. Reference 3 is the previous clothing design, keep its details but reference 1 wins for body geometry. Transparent background.
